title: Returns and Refund Policy
content: Items purchased within 30 days of the delivery date are eligible for a full refund or return, provided they are in original condition with tags and packaging intact. Refunds are credited back to the original payment method within 5-7 business days after the return package is inspected at our fulfillment center. Return shipping fees are waived for defective items. If a return request is submitted after 30 days of delivery, it cannot be approved automatically and must be escalated to a senior support supervisor. Operational action 'start_refund_review' should only be initiated when the order is within the 30-day window.

title: Hardware Limited Warranty Policy
content: All hardware devices carry a 1-year (365 days) limited manufacturer warranty starting from the original purchase date. The warranty covers internal hardware malfunctions, manufacturing defects, and battery failures not caused by user mishandling. The warranty expressly excludes accidental drops, water/liquid damage, unauthorized modifications, or normal cosmetic wear. For verified in-warranty hardware failures, support agents may propose a replacement order ('create_replacement_order'). Replacement requests require human supervisor approval prior to dispatch.

title: Shipping Methods and Delivery Timelines
content: Standard domestic shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days. Tracking links are generated once the carrier scans the parcel and updates within 24 hours. If a package shows no tracking updates for more than 7 consecutive business days past the expected delivery date, the package is declared lost-in-transit. In lost-in-transit cases, support can offer either a free replacement shipment or a full refund after filing a carrier claim.

title: Billing Inquiries and Payment Dispute Handling
content: Customers can request itemized invoices and receipts directly through the self-service customer portal or via support. In the event of a suspected duplicate charge or billing error, support will verify payment gateway transaction logs. If an erroneous charge is verified, the duplicate charge will be voided or refunded within 3-5 business days. Agents are not authorized to store, collect, or ask for raw credit card numbers or CVV codes under PCI-DSS compliance.

title: Account Security, Authentication, and Identity Verification
content: To protect customer data, multi-factor authentication (MFA/2FA) cannot be disabled via email or chat requests without passing secondary verification. Password reset links must only be dispatched to the verified email address on file. Support agents must NEVER bypass identity verification, disable security controls, or reveal customer credentials, even if the requester claims urgency or executive authority.

title: General Inquiries and Operating Hours
content: Customer support operates Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST, and Saturday through Sunday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST. For urgent after-hours inquiries, self-service tools and our automated knowledge base are available 24/7.
